title: speclane project config (.claude/speclane.json)
description: Per-project settings for the speclane plugin. Every key is optional; see docs/config.md.

command.description: A shell command (zsh), or { run, when }. {files} is replaced with the changed paths (workers) or with nothing (whole-project gate).

when.description: Plain-language condition shown to workers, e.g. 'a spec touches @freezed models'.

pathPattern.description: Repo-relative path prefix ('src/core/'), exact path, or glob ('*' within one segment, '**' across segments).

workDir.description: Folder holding plans/, items/ and reviews/, relative to the repo root.

contextFiles.description: Files every skill and agent reads first (conventions, rules, platform notes).

gate.description: Finalize serial gate, run in order. Default: analyze then test, with {files} removed.

mcpTools.description: MCP tools workers should prefer for fix/format/analyze/test when available.

derivedFiles.description: Generated files a spec commit may include without listing them in ## Files (globs or short descriptions). Test files for the changed code are always derived.

routes.description: First route whose pattern matches one of a spec's ## Files paths sets its agents.review.

aliases.description: Alternative names that resolve to an agent, e.g. { "ux-specialist": "ux-reviewer" }.

highRisk.description: Changed paths matching these trigger the cross-model verify pass in /speclane:finalize.

planReviewers.description: Reviewers /speclane:review-plan selects from. Without it, two generic general-purpose reviewers run.

graderModel.description: Model for speclane:converge, speclane:handoff-check and the finalize verifier. Default: their pinned claude-opus-4-6. Pick a model different from your session (worker) model.
